posts.title: Bithumb Users Face Phishing Risks After Reported Data Leak
posts.titleVi: Bithumb Users Face Phishing Risks After Reported Data Leak
posts.summary: Some customer personal data at South Korea’s second-largest crypto exchange, Bithumb, was reportedly leaked on October 28 after an external unauthorized party accessed one of its internal workplace tools.
posts.summaryVi: Some customer personal data at South Korea’s second-largest crypto exchange, Bithumb, was reportedly leaked on October 28 after an external unauthorized party accessed one of its internal workplace tools.
posts.content:
Some customer personal data at South Korea’s second-largest crypto exchange, Bithumb, was reportedly leaked on October 28 after an external unauthorized party accessed one of its internal workplace tools.

This is the latest in a string of similar incidents that have cut across crypto companies and traditional financial firms.

According to the Yonhap News Agency, the exchange detected abnormal access by an outsider without authority on October 27, inside its in-house mobile groupware system.

While the exchange is said to still be working out the exact scope of the breach, another firm, Daishin Securities, which was also hit, reported that information on more than 38,000 of its customers, including names, emails, and phone numbers, was leaked.

Mirae Asset Global Investment was also a victim, and Korea’s Financial Supervisory Service (FSS) is said to be investigating all three incidents and has already sent an on-site team to Daishin. At a meeting with the chairmen of eight bank holding companies, FSS Director Lee Chan-jin pressed the financial sector on IT security, saying:

“As artificial intelligence is used as a means of hacking, security vulnerabilities will be easily detected and simultaneous attacks will become a regular occurrence.”

He added that boards must now take the lead in improving the security capabilities of their companies.

Binance co-founder Changpeng Zhao (CZ) also reacted to the news, telling his 12.9 million followers on X that while they may not be able to prevent leaks, they could take measures to protect themselves, including reducing the information they share and locking down their accounts. Leaked exchange data, he pointed out, mostly feeds phishing and SIM-swapping attacks, and he recommended using a unique email alias for each exchange and hardware keys or passkeys instead of SMS codes.

“Assume anyone who contacts you about your account, ‘security issues,’ or ‘refund recovery’ is a scammer, even if they know your name, balance, or recent trades,” CZ cautioned.

The Bithumb case has come right in the middle of other security disclosures involving crypto businesses, with hardware wallet maker Foundation saying yesterday that its customers had been hit with more than 23,000 phishing emails sent from its official domain after hackers compromised its API keys on Cloudflare.

Recall that in August, a Trezor provider named ShipMonk had the names, locations, and emails of more than 67,000 users stolen , while more recently, Keystone Wallet, another major provider, reported that unauthorized people accessed its official website and stole the shipping information of its customers, although they did not compromise wallet passwords and private keys.

There was also an incident today involving Amplitude, a Coinbase vendor, where a subset of the exchange’s users reportedly had their contact details exposed, with SlowMist claiming that the hacker had gotten the details of more than 70,000 customers. However, Coinbase support rejected the breach label, stating that it had not seen any evidence of unauthorized people accessing its systems. It also told users that their funds were unaffected.

His passion for understanding financial systems has led to an intriguing interest in blockchain technology, and he enjoys exploring and writing about cryptocurrencies. posts.titleVi: Binance Alerts Users: Ethereum Deposits Paused and Major Delistings Ahead
posts.summary: The world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange will briefly suspend some important services on the Ethereum (ETH) network this week. It will also remove several trading pairs that no longer meet the required standards. Here’s everything users should know.
posts.summaryVi: The world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange will briefly suspend some important services on the Ethereum (ETH) network this week. It will also remove several trading pairs that no longer meet the required standards. Here’s everything users should know.
posts.content:
The world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange will briefly suspend some important services on the Ethereum (ETH) network this week.

It will also remove several trading pairs that no longer meet the required standards. Here’s everything users should know.

Binance will perform wallet maintenance on the ETH network on October 28, and deposits and withdrawals on that blockchain will be temporarily unavailable during the process. The effort is scheduled to take about one hour, after which operations will resume.

As usual, the company assured that token trading on the network will not be affected and promised to handle all user-related technical requirements.

“Deposits and withdrawals for token(s) on the aforementioned network will be reopened once the upgraded network is deemed to be stable. No further announcement will be posted,” the announcement reads.

Binance has performed many similar wallet maintenance events this year, with no reports of issues or user complaints. In August, it temporarily paused transfers on the Ethereum network, while prior to that, it briefly suspended TRX deposits and withdrawals.

Besides the update regarding the Ethereum network, Binance revealed that it will delist the following spot trading pairs: AAVE/BTC, ATOM/BTC, CAKE/BTC, DASH/BTC, ETC/BTC, ICP/BTC, PENDLE/BTC, RENDER/BTC, TAO/BTC, THETA/BTC, XAUT/BTC and XTZ/BTC on October 30.

The decision follows a rigorous check of all listed pairs on the platform, as the exchange regularly checks whether they meet certain standards such as adequate liquidity and trading volume.

“The delisting of a spot trading pair does not affect the availability of the tokens on Binance Spot. Users can still trade the spot trading pair’s base and quote assets on other trading pair(s) that are available on Binance,” the entity explained.

In addition, Binance will say goodbye to ten margin trading pairs on the same date. Those in question include RE/USD1, 币安人生/U, KAT/U, BTC/USDS, ETH/USDS, AVNT/U, FET/U, TRUMP/U, APT/U, WLFI/U.

Bitcoin apps risk massive fee drain, and 2 library bugs are blamed

Two Bitcoin library flaws could hide massive miner fees and let valid transactions bypass safety checks.

By Liam 'Akiba' Wright Editor-in-Chief • CryptoSlate

01 Bitcoinjs-lib's Oct. 26 advisories identify fee-accounting fixes in versions 5.2.2, 6.1.9 and 7.0.4 for the corresponding release lines. 02 Conflicting or missing input-value records can understate miner fees and defeat safeguards when applications trust the vulnerable library's accounting. 03 Actual loss requires an authorized, valid transaction to be broadcast and accepted; maintainers should upgrade or independently verify input values. Make CryptoSlate preferred on Share

Bitcoinjs-lib, a library used to build Bitcoin applications, has patched two bugs that can make software understate the miner fee a valid transaction would pay if broadcast and accepted.

The Oct. 26 security disclosures identify fixes in versions 5.2.2, 6.1.9 and 7.0.4 for the corresponding release lines.

The affected format is a partially signed Bitcoin transaction (PSBT), and BIP 174 defines it as a way to pass transaction information and signatures between clients. Signing, combining signatures, finalizing inputs, and extracting the transaction are separate functions, even when one application performs several of them.

The risk concerns applications that import these packages and trust bitcoinjs-lib's fee calculation or excessive-fee safeguard without independently checking the outputs being spent. Maintainers need to review their dependency version and how they validate imported PSBTs.

Why valid signatures can accompany misleading fees

A Bitcoin transaction's fee is the difference between the value of its inputs and its outputs, so understating an input makes the calculated fee look smaller.

In the first flaw, signing and fee accounting can use different values for the same input. Signing uses the full previous transaction, while fee accounting prefers a conflicting record containing a smaller value. As a result, the vulnerable software can authorize the real transaction while evaluating the wrong fee.

The advisory describes a demonstration on bitcoinjs-lib 7.0.1 in which the actual fee was 900,000,000 satoshi, but the library reported 200 satoshi. The signature verified, and extraction returned without the default fee-rate warning.

Related Reading Eclair merges fixes for Lightning flaws that could burn Bitcoin in fees

The second advisory describes finalized inputs with both input-value records missing. The calculator counts those inputs as zero, and an already-signed PSBT imported from another party can reach this calculation without needing another signing operation.

Its hypothetical example has a true fee of 91,000 satoshi but a reported fee of 1,000 satoshi. Finalized scripts and signatures alone do not establish the missing input's value.

A bitcoinjs-lib flaw could count missing PSBT input values as zero, hiding a much larger fee; patched releases now require every value. Actual loss requires an authorized, valid transaction to be broadcast and accepted by the network. These defects do not create signatures, and excess value becomes a miner fee.

For conflicting records, affected releases are 5.2.0 through 5.2.1, 6.0.0 through 6.1.8 including 6.1.0-rc.0, and 7.0.0-rc.0 through 7.0.3. The missing-record flaw affects the same v6 and v7 ranges, plus 5.1.0 through 5.2.1 in the v5 line.

The remediation gives signing and accounting a shared method for resolving previous outputs, rejects conflicting values or scripts, and requires an amount for every input during fee calculation. It also clears cached fees and extracted transactions after relevant metadata changes or combinations.

Maintainers unable to upgrade should independently verify referenced output values. Reject conflicting records before signing or trusting fees, and verify every input value before trusting fees or extracting a transaction.

Markets Bitcoin treasury Datavault AI plunges 50% after firm says it can’t access its BTC

The company said the accounting correction will cut reported assets by $92.2 million at the end of 2025 after bitcoin held on Biconomy could not be withdrawn.

By Shaurya Malwa Updated Oct 28, 2026, 7:34 a.m. EDT Published Oct 28, 2026, 1:28 a.m. EDT

2 min read Make preferred on Share 

Bitcoin treasury Datavault AI plunges 50% after firm says it can’t access its BTC. (Meg Boulden/Unsplash) Summary Show Datavault AI shares plunged nearly 50 percent Tuesday after the company disclosed that it had been unable to withdraw bitcoin from the Biconomy exchange since June and would restate its financial results. The company said bitcoin credited through Scilex Holding Company’s $150 million investment should have been recorded as an amount owed by Scilex, reducing reported assets by $92.2 million at the end of 2025 and $49 million as of June 2026. Datavault had treated the bitcoin as funding available to sustain operations, but the unresolved withdrawal now requires the company to reassess that assumption.

Datavault AI (DVLT) shares plunged nearly 50% on Tuesday after a filing revealed that the company had been unable to withdraw bitcoin from crypto exchange Biconomy since June and would have to restate its financial results.

Stocks of the Oregon, U.S.-based company closed at $0.067, down 49.55%, with roughly 244 million shares traded.

The problem traces back to a September 2025 agreement with Scilex Holding Company, which agreed to purchase $150 million of Datavault shares and warrants using bitcoin.

Scilex credited 1,309.04 BTC to Datavault’s account at Biconomy through off-chain transfers, meaning the balances changed within the exchange rather than through transactions on Bitcoin’s blockchain. Datavault subsequently sold 491.4 BTC back to Scilex for about $40.5 million in cash.

But the transfer could not be completed when it requested a withdrawal to an external account in June, the company said, and remained incomplete as of Monday’s filing.

Biconomy was also involved in supplying the bitcoin behind the investment. Scilex’s June financial report says it sold $200 million of shares in its subsidiary Semnur to Biconomy for bitcoin, then used $150 million to buy Datavault securities.

Datavault now says the bitcoin credited through Scilex’s investment should have been recorded as an amount Scilex owed for the shares. That amount would reduce shareholders’ equity instead of appearing among Datavault’s cryptocurrency assets.

The correction is expected to reduce reported assets by $92.2 million at the end of 2025 and $49 million as of June 2026. Datavault had counted those bitcoin balances as money it could draw on to keep the business running, but must now revisit the assessment.

CoinDesk contacted Biconomy about the withdrawal request and the bitcoin backing Datavault’s account and did not receive a response as of Asian afternoon hours Wednesday.

Tech Bithumb hacked through employee system as South Korean financial firms face cyberattacks

The breach hit an internal employee system that Bithumb says is separate from its trading platform, while the exchange is still determining whether customer information was exposed.

By Shaurya Malwa Oct 28, 2026, 1:10 a.m. EDT

2 min read Make preferred on Share 

Bithumb hacked through employee system as South Korean financial firms face cyberattacks. (Bithumb) Summary Show Bithumb said an outsider breached an internal employee mobile system and stole personal information, but no cryptocurrency funds were reported lost. The South Korean exchange said the compromised system was separate from its trading platform, though it has not disclosed how many people were affected or whether deposits and withdrawals were disrupted. The breach comes amid cyberattacks on South Korean financial firms and follows Bithumb’s erroneous $40 billion Bitcoin credit to customers in February.

Bithumb, South Korea’s second-largest crypto exchange, said earlier Wednesday an outsider broke into the internal mobile system its employees use to work and message each other and that personal information was taken.

No crypto funds were reported lost as of Asian afternoon hours. Bithumb is the second-largest exchange in South Korea by trading volumes.

The exchange found the intrusion on Tuesday and reported to the Korea Internet & Security Agency and the Personal Information Protection Commission, according to Korean media. It told Yonhap it was analyzing the exact scope, “including the possibility of member information being involved.”

It said the breached system runs separately from its trading platform, so “customer virtual assets cannot be accessed through this breach.” It has not said whether deposits or withdrawals were affected or how many people’s data was exposed.

Bithumb was one of three financial firms the Financial Supervisory Service said it was assessing on Wednesday. Daishin Securities said personal and credit information for 38,490 of its customers leaked in an outside attack. Mirae Asset Global Investments said it blocked abnormal access to some of its web systems and that investor information was not affected.

“I understand that major financial investment companies experienced overall hacking incidents yesterday,” FSS Governor Lee Chan-jin told a meeting with bank holding company chairs. Earlier in the month he said cyberattacks had hit 16 South Korean financial firms as of Oct. 14.

Meanwhile, this is a second hit to Bithumb’s controls this year.

In February it mistakenly credited customers with 620,000 BTC, worth more than $40 billion at the time, instead of 620,000 won. CEO Lee Jae-won blamed the error on weak internal controls at the time, saying the exchange was “acutely aware of the deficiency in internal system control.”

posts.title: XRP Whales Now Control 68.5% of Supply, Highest Level Since 2022
posts.titleVi: XRP Whales Now Control 68.5% of Supply, Highest Level Since 2022
posts.summary: XRP whales have held the largest share of the token’s supply since November 2022. Wallets holding at least 10 million XRP now control 46.87 billion tokens, or around 68.5% of the total supply. The increase comes as the price struggles near $1.3.
posts.summaryVi: XRP whales have held the largest share of the token’s supply since November 2022. Wallets holding at least 10 million XRP now control 46.87 billion tokens, or around 68.5% of the total supply. The increase comes as the price struggles near $1.3.
posts.content:
XRP whales have held the largest share of the token’s supply since November 2022. Wallets holding at least 10 million XRP now control 46.87 billion tokens, or around 68.5% of the total supply.

The increase comes as the price struggles near $1.3. According to Santiment, this shows that large holders continue to accumulate despite the current weakness.

The latest trend suggests major investors are maintaining their exposure while smaller traders may be losing confidence. But Santiment explained that the crypto asset still needs to clear important levels before a stronger recovery can take shape. The $1.3 mark remains a crucial level, while $1.5 could offer stronger confirmation of bullish momentum. Holding above $1.2, alongside continued whale accumulation, would support the outlook.

Further gains in whale holdings could strengthen the recovery case.

Meanwhile, XRP exchange outflows reached around 5.3 billion tokens over a 30-day period. The figure remains below the 6 billion XRP recorded in October. With approximately 2.206 billion tokens leaving, Binance accounted for the largest share. Next up was OKX with 501.51 million, followed by Bybit, which recorded 479.94 million in outflows. Upbit saw around 392.90 million XRP leave its platform, followed by Bitget at 243.39 million.

The outflows declined during the first half of August before picking up later that month. Higher levels continued through September and October, in a recovery from the quieter summer period. These movements may mean more XRP is moving into private wallets or other platforms. That could reduce the tokens readily available for sale on exchanges.

Additionally, the TD Sequential indicator has flashed a buy signal on the three-day chart. The last three similar signals were followed by rebounds of 31%, 24%, and 18%.

On the ETF front, however, US-listed spot XRP funds started the week with $3.61 million in outflows, reversing course after ending the previous week in positive territory.

On the corporate investment side of things, Evernorth Holdings is looking to raise up to $80.7 million through an equity facility with Cantor Fitzgerald. It plans to use part of the proceeds to buy more XRP, while also funding its operations and developing products across the XRP ecosystem.

The move comes as the company builds on its recently launched Nasdaq listing under the ticker XRPN. Evernorth already holds around 473 million XRP in its treasury and aims to generate returns through institutional strategies. It has also partnered with Ripple, Kraken, Coinbase, and BitGo to support those plans.

Additionally, Ripple is expanding its corporate treasury platform with AI-powered automation and round-the-clock payment services. Its new 24/7 Returns feature could allow eligible businesses to earn returns on qualifying digital assets, including RLUSD, beyond traditional banking hours.

Chayanika has been working as a financial journalist for seven years. A graduate in Political Science and Journalism, her interest lies in regulatory implications with a focus on technological evolution in the crypto realm.

Robinhood’s Tenev warns US tokenization uncertainty deters ‘serious assets’

Latest News Published Oct 28, 2026 Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev says tokenized equities need more than a temporary SEC exemption to flourish in the US.

Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev says uncertainty over the longevity of US tokenization rules could prevent investors from committing substantial assets to tokenized markets, despite the securities regulator opening a temporary path for onchain stock trading this year.

Speaking during Robinhood’s third-quarter earnings call Tuesday, Tenev welcomed the SEC’s innovation exemption but said further rulemaking or legislation would be needed to provide longer-term regulatory certainty.

“As far as the innovation exemption goes, I think it’s a really positive step... I do think more needs to be done to give people a little bit of certainty because as we talk to customers, I think the uncertainty of what happens in five years is likely to be an impediment to, like, putting serious assets onto this technology.”

Tokenized stock offerings have faced resistance from traditional issuers. Microsoft, Alphabet and Goldman Sachs were among 16 companies that objected to their shares being offered on the proposed OKXICE venue, while AMC CEO Adam Aron separately criticized Robinhood’s tokenized stock products.

Despite the regulatory uncertainty, Binance Research projects that the tokenized equities market could grow to $349 billion by 2030 under its base-case scenario, from $4.43 billion as of Sept. 15.

Related: SEC flags tokenization as high-risk area in 2027 market examinations

“So I still think some rule-making or legislation is going to be necessary, even though, of course, it’s a positive step, and we hope to have more to share on our own US tokenization plans in the near future,” said Tenev.

Asked about private-company stock tokens, Tenev said Robinhood intends to launch those products overseas, subject to regulatory arrangements. In the US, Tenev said the company is working to find a path that satisfies current accreditation constraints.

Robinhood offers around 200 stock tokens on Robinhood Chain . The products are backed by underlying shares but structured as tokenized debt securities, providing economic exposure without the same shareholder rights as conventional stocks.

That distinction leaves their current structure outside the SEC’s innovation exemption, which requires equivalent rights, including dividends and voting rights.

Tenev’s comments came as Robinhood reported a 55% year-on-year fall in cryptocurrency revenue to $120 million in the third quarter, while crypto notional trading volume declined 38% to $50 billion.

BNY offers XRP custody, but only 1 rollout type exists

Eligible clients can now hold XRP through BNY, while transfers of existing tokens would not establish additional purchases.

By Liam 'Akiba' Wright Editor-in-Chief • CryptoSlate

01 BNY now supports XRP and RLUSD custody for eligible institutional clients, adding another route to hold and transfer the tokens. 02 Ripple's announcement discloses no XRP custody balance or new purchase, leaving additional acquisitions as the test of incremental demand. 03 C2FO plans RLUSD settlement on XRPL through a limited rollout, with a waitlist and US-only access at launch. Make CryptoSlate preferred on Share

BNY now supports custody of XRP and Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin for eligible institutional clients, according to an Oct. 27 announcement from Ripple, giving institutions another way to hold and transfer the XRP Ledger's native token.

The service offers a banking route to safeguard the asset and manage its operations. BNY describes its platform as connecting custody with settlement, accounting and servicing.

The announcement names no funded XRP custody client and discloses neither an XRP balance nor an incremental purchase. Moving tokens that clients already own to BNY would change their custodian without necessarily creating demand for more coins.

BNY’s XRP custody supports transfers and client allocations, but the announcement does not disclose balances or new purchases. What BNY's custody support changes

The change provides a route to custody XRP within BNY's servicing platform. The bank's existing workaround for stablecoins and tokenized assets provides context, but XRP custody directly concerns the token an institution would own.

BNY says its general custody platform uses segregated wallets, operational controls, and oversight. It also presents digital and traditional assets in a combined environment for settlement, accounting and servicing, which can simplify reconciliation and asset administration.

Those functions address how an institution manages an asset after deciding to hold it, and they can reduce operational friction. Yet, custody availability alone does not establish that every institution has the mandate, approvals, or appetite to acquire XRP.

Neither the release nor BNY's platform description provides an XRP-specific list of eligible customers or jurisdictions. BNY says the availability of accounts, products and services varies by customer and location.

Its Oct. 8 European custody expansion was for select institutions. That earlier announcement did not establish XRP-specific availability across the EU, so the bank's geographic presence cannot be treated as a map of where the new XRP service is accessible.

The relationship with Ripple already covered a different layer of digital finance. BNY's selection as RLUSD's primary reserve custodian was announced on July 9, 2025 , involving the reserve assets and cash that support the stablecoin. The Oct. 27 release also cites its custody relationship with Ripple Prime.

Related Reading Standard Chartered brings Ripple's RLUSD into banking custody after $765 million quarterly surge

The clearest evidence of service use would be XRP deposited into funded client custody accounts. But a balance at BNY would answer only part of the demand question: it would show tokens held there, while leaving open how those tokens were acquired.

Consider an institution that already owns XRP at another custodian. Transferring that position to BNY could increase the bank's reported XRP holdings without any additional market purchase. The same tokens would have a new custody arrangement.

A client acquiring more XRP for a new allocation would be a different development. Connecting custody growth to that kind of acquisition would show the service accompanying additional buying. Establishing that BNY's new access caused the purchase would require a further link to the client's investment decision.

Even growth in a dollar-denominated custody total would need care. A higher token price can lift the value of assets held without increasing the number of XRP. Token balances and evidence of new acquisitions would be more informative together than a custody valuation alone.

Client custody support also provides no basis for treating BNY as an XRP buyer for its own balance sheet. A bank providing safekeeping and a client deciding to acquire tokens are separate participants and decisions.

C2FO, a working-capital platform that helps businesses obtain early payment on approved invoices, announced a separate initiative with Ripple on Oct. 27 . The companies plan to bring financing and settlement supporting C2FO Instant Pay onto the XRP Ledger, using RLUSD for settlement.

The initiative aims to shorten the settlement delay after early payment is arranged, and the relevant follow-up is how much XRP the service would need to operate when its settlement asset is RLUSD.

C2FO's historical working-capital activity describes existing early-payment programs, rather than verified Instant Pay volume settled on XRPL.

The Instant Pay product page sets out the rollout limits: businesses can join a waitlist, access will expand through a limited rollout over the coming months, and the offering will be available only in the US at launch.

The rollout qualifications leave actual uptake and settlement volumes as developments still to observe.

Ripple and BNY say they are examining a C2FO supply-chain financing initiative intended to broaden investor access to approved receivables, subject to client requirements.

They also intend to expand support for XRPL-issued assets and work toward direct RLUSD minting and redemption for BNY clients.

These plans do not establish that invoice principal will be purchased or held in XRP, or that the proposed BNY minting, redemption and financing services have begun.

The ledger's transaction-cost documentation lists a current minimum of 10 drops for a standard transaction, potentially rising under load, with the fee destroyed. Its reserve documentation lists a 1 XRP base reserve and generally 0.2 XRP per qualifying owned ledger item, with exceptions.

Those requirements do not rise dollar for dollar with the principal of an invoice settled in RLUSD. Any larger XRP liquidity or inventory requirement tied to C2FO would need separate evidence about how the service actually operates.

Funded XRP balances and evidence of clients' additional acquisitions would show how institutions use BNY's newly available custody.

C2FO's rollout and settlement activity would answer a separate question about ledger use. For XRP holders, each would be more informative than treating the availability of a service as a measure of token buying.

Bithumb discloses data leak after internal system breach: Report

Latest News Published Oct 28, 2026 The breach impacted its in-house mobile system, used by employees for work and information sharing.

South Korea’s crypto exchange Bithumb is investigating the extent of a data leak caused by a hack of its internal mobile system earlier this week, Yonhap News Agency reported Wednesday.

Bithumb discovered the breach of its in-house mobile system — the platform used by employees to communicate internally — on Tuesday and notified the Korea Internet & Security Agency and the Personal Information Protection Commission that day, according to Yonhap , which cited industry sources.

The exchange is investigating the scope of the attack, including whether member data was leaked.

“We are analyzing the exact scope, including the possibility of member information being involved,” Bithumb told Yonhap. “We will provide an official announcement this morning. However, the internal work system is separated from the virtual asset trading system, so customer virtual assets cannot be accessed through this breach.”

Cointelegraph reached out to Bithumb for further comment.

The incident adds to a recent wave of cyberattacks in Korea’s financial sector.

During a meeting at the Financial Supervisory Authority headquarters on Wednesday, Governor Lee Chan-jin said cyberattacks had hit 16 South Korean financial firms as of Oct. 14.

The Korea Times reports that asset manager Mirae Asset Global Investments and Daishin Securities were also recent victims of cyberattacks.

Daishin Securities said that personal and credit information belonging to 38,490 customers had been leaked. Mirae Asset Global Investments said it had blocked abnormal external access to some web systems and was investigating the incident. The company said investor information was not affected, according to Yonhap.

posts.content:
X100 governance flaws trigger $6M loss due to a flash loan

X100’s attacker repaid a flash loan from theft proceeds while its stake stayed locked, and Arkadiko’s ballot accepted late token purchases.

By Liam 'Akiba' Wright Editor-in-Chief • CryptoSlate

01 X100’s attacker gained two Senate seats and repaid its flash loan while the purchased stake remained locked for a year. 02 Arkadiko’s roughly five-day ballot admitted late token purchases, then activated a malicious contract without a separate execution delay. 03 Arkadiko restored its legitimate contract entry on Oct. 27, but that change alone does not establish recovered collateral or compensation. Make CryptoSlate preferred on Share

An attacker still acquired two governance seats on X100, a token project with a Senate-governed treasury, and approved a treasury transaction and repaid a flash loan in a single blockchain transaction on Oct. 24.

At Arkadiko, a lending protocol where users borrow against vault collateral, a roughly five-day vote ended two days early, giving a malicious contract authority over vault assets. People bought voting tokens shortly before the decisive vote, and the proposal took effect when the ballot closed.

The incidents expose different gaps between committing money, qualifying to vote, and executing an approved action. X100 tokens should be locked for a year, so a long token lock can impose a cost without delaying authority.

Meanwhile, a lengthy ballot can provide notice while still admitting late purchases. Neither automatically creates time to respond after a decision becomes executable.

X100’s locked stake bought immediate authority

X100’s Freezer contract holds frozen X tokens and supplies the stake used to rank candidates for its Senate. Its lock terms run for one, three, or five years, but Senate eligibility uses the amount currently frozen , without a minimum stake age.

In the first Oct. 24 attack, two helper contracts each froze 19,000.000001 X under the one-year term. They registered, entered the ranking, and supplied the two supporting votes that executed proposal 7. They completed the stake, votes, and execution in a single transaction.

Written by Felix Ng staff editor Edited by Yohan Yun staff editor Written by Felix Ng staff editor Edited by Yohan Yun staff editor

Discord is making public chats searchable on Google: How to opt out

Latest News Published Oct 28, 2026 Discord conversations on large public servers will soon reach audiences far beyond their communities, raising privacy concerns.

Discord is making a policy change that will make conversations from its largest public servers discoverable in search engines, including Google, raising privacy concerns among users whose conversations were previously confined to the platform.

The change applies to Discoverable Servers — communities with at least 1,000 members listed in Discord’s public directory that do not require an invitation to join.

From Nov. 16, every Discoverable Server will have a web page that may include summaries of public channel discussions. From mid-December, individual messages posted in eligible channels may appear in web search, Discord said Tuesday. Messages posted before the rollout will not be included, while usernames and avatars will be excluded from published messages.

Example of an individual message being shown online. Source: Discord

Discord said the shift of online communities from message boards to its servers had made useful answers harder to find. “This has led to valuable information being locked in Discord conversations, inaccessible to the wider internet. We want to fix this,” the company said.

The move has drawn criticism from users concerned about their conversations reaching an audience outside of their intended community, even if the servers are public in the first place.

Related: Starknet introduces wallet privacy feature for DeFi activity

Others welcomed the change, saying it could make useful answers easier to find. One user in Discord’s announcement thread called it “very much necessary,” while another said moving communities from forums to Discord had made their discussions harder to find through search.

The change could also affect cryptocurrency communities that use Discord for technical discussions, support and project announcements.

Cointelegraph found nearly 800 servers tagged “cryptocurrency,” around 1,400 tagged “trading” and more than 700 tagged “finance” in Discord’s public directory. Discord said there are over 63,000 total discoverable servers on its platform.

Users have until the message-sharing rollout begins in mid-December to opt out before their posts become eligible to appear online. Discord said the feature will be disabled by default for users in Australia, the EU, the European Economic Area, the UK, Canada, Brazil and South Korea. Teen users will also be excluded.

To opt out, users should go into User Settings > Data & Privacy and switch off “Show my message content from Discoverable channels on web pages.” The setting covers every Discoverable Server a user belongs to, according to Discord’s guidance .

How users can opt out of having their messages visible on web pages. Source: Discord

Users can also disable the feature after launch, but it only protects messages sent after the opt-out. Users who want an eligible message removed must delete it from Discord, and Discord warns that search engines may retain cached copies for some time.

Server administrators can also prevent messages from individual channels or entire servers from appearing on public web pages and in search results through Server Settings > Web Presence.

They can separately disable discussion summaries, which are scheduled to begin rolling out in November.

posts.content:
Polymarket reforms Bitcoin contracts and Binance trading spikes immediately drop

A newer study finds the earlier Binance trading pattern subsided after averaging, but historical wallet gains cannot quantify current losses.

By Liam 'Akiba' Wright Editor-in-Chief • CryptoSlate

Published Oct. 27, 2026 Updated Oct. 28, 2026

01 Polymarket’s five-minute Bitcoin markets have used 60-second averages for both opening and closing benchmarks since Aug. 14. 02 Wang’s early post-change sample found the earlier Binance settlement-time pattern subsided, without measuring current wallet losses. 03 Historical wallet gains cannot establish current exposure or combined strategy profits after underlying-market trades and execution costs. Make CryptoSlate preferred on Share

Polymarket’s five-minute Bitcoin contract sampled on Oct. 27 uses averaged opening and closing benchmarks, following an August reform that changed the incentive to move its settlement price.

The current design requires a different risk assessment from the single-snapshot rule examined in earlier research.

An estimate of about $8.2 million earned by 821 wallets in earlier pushed cycles belongs to that historical research. Guangzhe Wang’s newer study cites the finding from Dai and co-authors.

Wang’s before-and-after results instead point to a subsiding Binance trading pattern in the first weeks after averaging. That gives the reform an empirical test, while keeping separate whether an observed settlement-time pattern declined and how much traders lose under the current rule.

The Oct. 27 Bitcoin market , covering 12:20-12:25 p.m. ET, names Chainlink’s BTC/USD 60-second time-weighted average price (TWAP) as its resolution source. Up wins when the ending benchmark is at least as high as the opening benchmark, and Down wins otherwise.

The Dai, Jia and Yu working paper , submitted to arXiv on June 30, reported settlement-time spot-flow spikes and subsequent reversals after the five-minute contract’s launch. The broader finding concerns the incentive to move the underlying reference market.

Wang’s newer paper examined Binance one-second data from July 1, 2025, through Sept. 4, 2026, with 82,752 Bitcoin boundaries where only the five-minute contract settled. For each sampled five-minute window, he measured the share of Binance volume traded in its final ten seconds:

Regime Final-ten-second volume share Before five-minute contract launch 3.05% Single-snapshot settlement 5.68% 60-second average settlement 3.02% In the first three weeks of the 60-second regime, Wang found no systematic migration into earlier bins and no recurrence of the earlier near-strike reversal pattern.

That bounded observation is consistent with the reform’s effectiveness for the measured pattern. It is neither a current wallet-profit audit nor proof that every possible manipulation strategy has disappeared.

The study tests an observed response to the reform, and its outcome is a trading pattern.

According to Polymarket’s changelog , crypto up/down markets switched from single snapshots to Chainlink-computed averages on Aug. 7. Both the opening price to beat and the final settlement value moved to the applicable TWAP feed.

On Aug. 14 at 00:00 UTC, the platform extended five-minute crypto markets to 60 seconds. The October contract reflects an operating rule introduced more than two months earlier, and its five-minute duration should not be confused with its one-minute benchmark window.

Under a snapshot rule, an unusually brief move can be important if it affects the selected reference price. Under an average, its contribution depends on how much of the measurement window it influences.

The economic question becomes whether the benefit on the prediction-market position exceeds the cost of affecting that average and executing the strategy.

A historical dollar gain cannot be carried into that changed calculation without evidence that the old behavior and economics still apply.

Thanks for signing up to The Catalyst. Look out for your first daily email. If you already receive it, you’re all set.

Polymarket’s documentation says it takes the applicable average, just as it does for the closing value. Evaluating a disputed result requires the reference values used at both boundaries, along with the relevant report timing.

Polymarket’s five-minute Bitcoin contracts now compare Chainlink’s opening and closing 60-second TWAPs instead of single-price snapshots. Chainlink’s timestamp documentation explains why the time printed on an exchange chart is insufficient. Each underlying report has a validity start and an observation timestamp, but report widths can vary, including when a later report absorbs a gap. The TWAP weights prices by the duration they cover.

The average also rolls with the latest observation rather than automatically snapping to a round clock minute. A 60-second TWAP is therefore neither the average price across the entire five-minute bet nor necessarily sixty equally weighted ticks.

Related Reading Fake election polls expose a Kalshi loophole that could leave traders paying for fraud

A gain on a prediction-market position and the net return from a strategy involving the underlying asset are different measurements. If moving Bitcoin’s reference price requires trading Bitcoin, that leg and its execution costs belong in the profitability calculation.

Polymarket Institute distinguishes the decentralized international exchange from Polymarket US, with separate APIs and separately managed data.

Talos’s Oct. 27 quarterly review highlights its Kalshi integration and points to earlier analysis of potential Polymarket settlement manipulation.

The remaining measurement is financial as well as behavioral: gains and losses under the averaged rule, with the relevant underlying-market trades and execution costs accounted for.

Under a snapshot rule, an unusually brief move can be important if it affects the selected reference price. Under an average, its contribution depends on how much of the measurement window it influences.

The economic question becomes whether the benefit on the prediction-market position exceeds the cost of affecting that average and executing the strategy.

A historical dollar gain cannot be carried into that changed calculation without evidence that the old behavior and economics still apply.

Chainlink’s timestamp documentation explains why the time printed on an exchange chart is insufficient. Each underlying report has a validity start and an observation timestamp, but report widths can vary, including when a later report absorbs a gap. The TWAP weights prices by the duration they cover.

posts.titleVi: South Korea May Suspend Crypto Tax Again: 2029 Now the Leading Target Date
posts.summary: South Korea is likely to postpone its crypto income tax for a fourth time, as Newsis reported on October 26, after an official from the presidential office, also known as the Blue House, confirmed that a delay is under discussion.
posts.summaryVi: South Korea is likely to postpone its crypto income tax for a fourth time, as Newsis reported on October 26, after an official from the presidential office, also known as the Blue House, confirmed that a delay is under discussion.
posts.content:
South Korea is likely to postpone its crypto income tax for a fourth time, as Newsis reported on October 26, after an official from the presidential office, also known as the Blue House, confirmed that a delay is under discussion.

January 2029, when the United States is due to join the OECD’s crypto information-sharing network, is the most probable new start date.

“Taxation of virtual assets is being discussed with a view to delaying implementation,” a Blue House official stated on October 25.

Lawmakers and the government are expected to amend the Income Tax Act during the tax law reform debate that begins in November, with consultations with relevant organizations starting as early as October 26. A government official said the final call will probably come between late November and early December.

At the center of the case sits the United States. Almost half of the virtual asset market is there, the official pointed out, and “the biggest obstacle is that the United States does not provide us with taxation information.” Without that data, tax officers would have to trace American exchange activity one account at a time, and the tax could end up falling mostly on users of domestic exchanges.

The OECD’s Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework (CARF) starts running next year, with 46 countries including South Korea beginning data exchanges. Canada, Switzerland, Hong Kong, and Singapore are among 29 countries that join in 2028, with Washington’s first exchange set for 2029.

Seoul initially favored a January 2027 start, arguing that overseas financial account reporting could help collect foreign tax information, but calls for a moratorium from both the opposition and the ruling party, along with related bills, shifted the government toward suspension.

Introduced in 2020 through an Income Tax Act revision, the levy takes 22% (local taxes included) of gains above 2.5 million won, about $1,886, once acquisition costs are deducted. But the Korean parliament has already suspended it three times.

Public pressure is building too. A petition seeking a two-year postponement reached the 50,000-signature threshold on the National Assembly’s electronic petition system, which sends such petitions to a standing committee for review. An anonymous petitioner wrote that “most crypto investors are sitting on heavy losses” and that taxing now is unfair to young people.

The petition also argued that the tax would push investors to offshore platforms, though as CryptoPotato reported, regulators ordered blocks on 27 overseas exchanges on October 13, KuCoin and MEXC among them. A May petition to abolish the tax reached 50,000 signatures in eight days but went no further after referral to a committee.

The proposed 2029 date is similar to that suggested in a bill introduced by Democratic Party of Korea lawmaker Park Min-gyu, which is seeking to postpone taxation until January 1 of that year. Still, the government hasn’t finalized its decision, and the timetable is still subject to parliamentary debate.

posts.content:
Zcash’s $125 million funding fight widens as Tyler Winklevoss calls to end its ‘USAID’

Tyler Winklevoss and prominent developers want to dismantle the privacy network's grant programs, even as Grayscale credits their funding model with years of innovation.

By Oluwapelumi Adejumo Senior Reporter • CryptoSlate

01 Zcash faces competing proposals to scrap its development fund after co-founder Sean Bowe called for ending payments to a $125 million grants program. 02 Tyler Winklevoss and Josh Swihart back broader cuts, threatening a funding model Grayscale credits with sustaining Zcash's technological innovation. 03 A rival proposal would preserve reduced funding until 2036, leaving Zcash divided over how to finance future upgrades as privacy adoption surges. Make CryptoSlate preferred on Share

Zcash faces competing proposals to scrap or extend developer subsidies as growing investor interest swells the privacy network's funding reserves.

The debate intensified after Zcash co-founder Sean Bowe proposed ending automatic payments to Zcash Community Grants (ZCG), arguing that the program already controls enough resources to finance years of development without additional subsidies.

His proposal has drawn more aggressive demands from ZODL founder Josh Swihart, Gemini co-founder Tyler Winklevoss, and other ecosystem participants, while a rival plan would preserve reduced development funding until 2036.

The disagreement comes as Zcash approaches its 10th anniversary on Oct. 28, with renewed institutional interest and rising private transaction activity increasing scrutiny of how the network allocates newly created ZEC .

Zcash's $125 million treasury triggers calls to dismantle grants program

In an Oct. 26 draft proposal , Bowe called for redirecting ZCG's 8% share of block rewards into the Network Sustainability Mechanism (NSM), a protocol reserve that would eventually support future block rewards. Bowe said on X:

“It's time to turn off the ZCG funding stream.”

He added that ZCG has more than $125 million in funding and would receive millions more before the proposed cutoff, arguing that the program was never designed to manage such substantial resources.

The figure is based on approximately 91,453 ZEC, $8.8 million in dollar-denominated assets, and $2.4 million in outstanding obligations, assuming ZEC trades at $1,300.

At that valuation, ZCG's annual allocation would be worth approximately $68.3 million, compared with $6.12 million in annualized expenses based on its first-quarter spending.

Bowe's proposal would preserve the program's existing assets and leave the separate 12% coinholder-controlled funding stream untouched.

However, Maxime Desalle proposed going further by dissolving ZCG entirely, stopping new grant approvals and transferring its remaining treasury to the NSM after fulfilling existing commitments.

Desalle argued that ZCG's governance structure lets a small community advisory panel influence spending despite the wider economic costs borne by ZEC holders.

He also disclosed his involvement with Cypherpunk, a major Zcash mining company, through his work, while maintaining that the proposal was independent of his employment.

Bowe later said he would personally support considering transferring ZCG's existing treasury, though he preferred to separate that decision from his proposal to stop future payments.

Winklevoss and Swihart push for broader cuts as rival plan emerges

The dispute has expanded beyond ZCG's future.

Tyler Winklevoss endorsed ending the grants arrangement, declaring, “It's time to end the USAID of Zcash.”

Swihart, meanwhile, argued that eliminating only ZCG's allocation would leave the underlying controversy unresolved. He said :

“It'd be a mistake to kill only one part of the dev fund. If dissolved, then no half measures, dissolve it all, both the ZCG and coinholder streams.”

Swihart pointed out that the coinholder-controlled program receives approximately 216 ZEC daily, creating a similar accumulation problem as the cryptocurrency appreciates.

He proposed eliminating both funding streams and redirecting their allocations to the NSM, honoring existing grant obligations before transferring remaining eligible funds.

Swihart also suggested a one-time, coinholder-approved legal defense endowment for Zcash developers. He said:

Thanks for signing up to The Catalyst. Look out for your first daily email. If you already receive it, you’re all set.

“A half measure leaves the door open to ongoing debate and politics. Markets like certainty.”

Notably, Swihart acknowledged that his company, ZODL, recently received a retroactive coinholder grant for core protocol development and could seek additional funding if the program survived. His proposal would eliminate that potential source of financing.

Yet the push to dismantle development funding is facing an alternative.

In an Oct. 27 draft , community contributor Dismad proposed gradually reducing the combined developer allocation from 20% to 10% around the 2028 halving, then to 5% in 2032, before eliminating it in 2036.

Related Reading Cypherpunk secures a $46M Zcash gain and turns a $4.7M operating loss into $39.4M profit

That approach would preserve existing governance arrangements while giving developers another decade of progressively declining protocol funding.

The competing plans would therefore produce substantially different outcomes: Bowe would end new ZCG payments, Desalle would dismantle the grants institution, Swihart would eliminate the entire development fund, and Dismad would extend a reduced version beyond its scheduled 2028 expiration.

Zcash's growing popularity raises stakes for future development

The growing calls to eliminate development subsidies contrast with Grayscale's view that protocol-funded research has kept Zcash technologically competitive over the past decade.

The asset manager highlighted the network's successive privacy upgrades, including Sapling, Orchard and the recently introduced Ironwood pool, as examples of improvements supported by dedicated development financing.

Grayscale argued that continued investment would be necessary to expand transaction capacity, prepare for quantum-computing threats and address emerging cybersecurity risks.

It said future innovation “will likely require ongoing financial support for developers from a variety of sources,” alongside more efficient capital allocation.

That assessment comes as Zcash sees substantial growth in both market value and network activity.

According to ZecStats , ZEC has gained about 260% over the past year, trading above $1,200 and pushing its market capitalization past $20 billion. The token has also appreciated roughly twentyfold since the beginning of 2025, when it traded near $60.

The rally has coincided with increased usage of the network's privacy features.

ZecStats data shows that Zcash processed an average of approximately 11,300 transactions daily in late October, an increase of about 70% from a year earlier. Shielded transactions accounted for roughly 62% of activity, up from about 24% during the same period in 2025.

Meanwhile, approximately 4.96 million ZEC, representing 29% of issued supply, are held in shielded pools that allow users to conceal transaction information.

The expansion has also reached traditional investment markets. Grayscale's Zcash exchange-traded product (ZCSH) reported approximately $708 million in net assets as of Oct. 26, reflecting the scale of institutional investment exposure that has developed around the cryptocurrency.

VanEck launches diversified ETF combining stocks, bonds and Bitcoin exposure

Latest News Published Oct 27, 2026 VanEck’s new Wealth Builder ETF targets a 2% Bitcoin allocation, with a permitted range of 1% to 5%, gaining exposure through a spot Bitcoin ETP.

US asset manager VanEck has launched an actively managed exchange-traded fund (ETF) that combines stocks, bonds and real assets with a targeted allocation to Bitcoin.

According to Tuesday’s announcement, the VanEck Wealth Builder ETF (NYSE: WBMO) invests in both VanEck and third-party ETFs, with a target Bitcoin allocation of 2% and a permitted range of 1% to 5%, according to the company’s website . Bitcoin exposure comes through a spot Bitcoin ETP rather than direct holdings of the cryptocurrency.

The fund builds on VanEck’s existing Wealth Builder model portfolios, previously available to financial advisers through third-party wealth management platforms. Its strategy incorporates exposure to global equities, fixed income, gold and other real assets, with allocations managed and rebalanced by VanEck.

“The traditional 60/40 portfolio was built for a different investment landscape,” said David Schassler, VanEck’s head of multi-asset solutions.

He said adding real assets alongside stocks and bonds could help investors navigate a wider range of economic conditions.

The launch follows VanEck’s March partnership with retirement platform Basic Capital, which made a selection of the asset manager’s digital asset exchange-traded products available through US employer-sponsored 401(k) plans. VanEck managed about $244.1 billion in assets as of Sept. 30, according to the company.

Tin tức mới nhất được xuất bản vào ngày 27 tháng 10 năm 2026 Wealth Builder ETF mới của VanEck nhắm mục tiêu phân bổ 2% Bitcoin, với phạm vi cho phép từ 1% đến 5%, đạt được mức tiếp xúc thông qua Bitcoin ETP giao ngay.

Nhà quản lý tài sản Hoa Kỳ VanEck đã ra mắt một quỹ giao dịch trao đổi (ETF) được quản lý tích cực, kết hợp cổ phiếu, trái phiếu và tài sản thực với sự phân bổ có mục tiêu cho Bitcoin.

Theo thông báo hôm thứ Ba, VanEck Wealth Builder ETF (NYSE: WBMO) đầu tư vào cả VanEck và ETF của bên thứ ba, với mục tiêu phân bổ Bitcoin là 2% và phạm vi cho phép từ 1% đến 5%, theo trang web của công ty. Việc tiếp xúc với bitcoin thông qua Bitcoin ETP giao ngay thay vì nắm giữ trực tiếp tiền điện tử.

Quỹ này được xây dựng dựa trên danh mục đầu tư theo mô hình Wealth Builder hiện có của VanEck, trước đây có sẵn cho các cố vấn tài chính thông qua nền tảng quản lý tài sản của bên thứ ba. Chiến lược của nó kết hợp việc tiếp cận với cổ phiếu toàn cầu, thu nhập cố định, vàng và các tài sản thực khác, với các khoản phân bổ được quản lý và cân bằng lại bởi VanEck.

David Schassler, người đứng đầu bộ phận giải pháp đa tài sản của VanEck, cho biết: “Danh mục đầu tư 60/40 truyền thống được xây dựng cho một bối cảnh đầu tư khác.

Ông cho biết việc bổ sung tài sản thực cùng với cổ phiếu và trái phiếu có thể giúp các nhà đầu tư điều hướng được nhiều điều kiện kinh tế hơn.

Sự ra mắt này diễn ra sau mối quan hệ hợp tác vào tháng 3 của VanEck với nền tảng hưu trí Basic Capital, nền tảng này đã cung cấp các sản phẩm giao dịch trao đổi tài sản kỹ thuật số của người quản lý tài sản thông qua các kế hoạch 401(k) do nhà tuyển dụng Hoa Kỳ tài trợ. Theo công ty, VanEck quản lý khoảng 244,1 tỷ USD tài sản tính đến ngày 30 tháng 9.

Intel, IBM, Oracle and IonQ latest to object to OKX-ICE tokenized stocks

Latest News Published Oct 27, 2026 More than 40% of the companies initially proposed to have their stocks listed in tokenized form have asked to opt-out.

Four companies have joined the list of those filing objections to listings on a tokenized stock exchange proposed by cryptocurrency exchange OKX and the parent company of the New York Stock Exchange, Intercontinental Exchange (ICE).

In a Monday update to its proposed OKXICE exchange, the crypto company reported that Intel, IBM, Oracle and IonQ were the most recent companies to object to having their US stocks listed in tokenized form. With the addition of the four, 26 companies have now filed to raise objections to OKXICE’s plans, including Alphabet, Wells Fargo and Goldman Sachs.

The proposed offering came just a few weeks after the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) approved temporary innovation exemptions for tokenized US stocks. Under the SEC exemption, Tokenized Securities Venues (TSVs) can offer limited trading for tokenized National Market System (NMS) stocks.

Many of the companies to opt out of the OKXICE plans currently have US listings on Nasdaq and the New York Stock Exchange. In September, Nasdaq released guidance for companies considering the innovation exemption, saying issuers should be “cautious” about participating. The exchange invested $100 million in Kraken parent Payward in September as part of its own push into tokenized assets.

OKXICE proposed 62 companies listing tokenized stocks when it filed with the SEC under the exemption, meaning about 41% of the entities have chosen not to participate as of Monday. Former New York Governor Andrew Cuomo, co-chair of the tokenization venture, said it was a “very natural response” for some companies to object, and he expected to see more names added to the list.

Intel, IBM, Oracle và IonQ mới nhất phản đối cổ phiếu được token hóa OKX-ICE

Tin tức mới nhất được xuất bản vào ngày 27 tháng 10 năm 2026 Hơn 40% các công ty ban đầu đề xuất niêm yết cổ phiếu của họ dưới dạng token hóa đã yêu cầu từ chối.

Bốn công ty đã gia nhập danh sách những người nộp đơn phản đối việc niêm yết trên sàn giao dịch chứng khoán token hóa do sàn giao dịch tiền điện tử OKX và công ty mẹ của Sở giao dịch chứng khoán New York, Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) đề xuất.

Trong bản cập nhật hôm thứ Hai cho sàn giao dịch OKXICE được đề xuất, công ty tiền điện tử đã báo cáo rằng Intel, IBM, Oracle và IonQ là những công ty gần đây nhất phản đối việc niêm yết cổ phiếu tại Hoa Kỳ của họ dưới dạng token hóa. Với việc bổ sung bốn công ty này, 26 công ty hiện đã đệ đơn phản đối kế hoạch của OKXICE, bao gồm Alphabet, Wells Fargo và Goldman Sachs.

Đề xuất được đưa ra chỉ vài tuần sau khi Ủy ban Chứng khoán và Giao dịch Hoa Kỳ (SEC) phê duyệt miễn trừ đổi mới tạm thời đối với các cổ phiếu được token hóa của Hoa Kỳ. Theo sự miễn trừ của SEC, các Địa điểm Chứng khoán Tokenized (TSV) có thể cung cấp giao dịch hạn chế đối với các cổ phiếu của Hệ thống Thị trường Quốc gia (NMS) được token hóa.

Nhiều công ty từ chối tham gia chương trình OKXICE hiện đã niêm yết tại Hoa Kỳ trên Nasdaq và Sở giao dịch chứng khoán New York. Vào tháng 9, Nasdaq đã đưa ra hướng dẫn dành cho các công ty đang xem xét miễn trừ đổi mới, đồng thời yêu cầu các tổ chức phát hành nên “thận trọng” khi tham gia. Sàn giao dịch đã đầu tư 100 triệu đô la vào Payward, công ty mẹ của Kraken vào tháng 9 như một phần trong nỗ lực thúc đẩy tài sản mã hóa của chính họ.

OKXICE đã đề xuất 62 công ty niêm yết cổ phiếu token hóa khi nộp đơn xin miễn trừ lên SEC, nghĩa là khoảng 41% thực thể đã chọn không tham gia kể từ thứ Hai. Cựu Thống đốc New York Andrew Cuomo, đồng chủ tịch của liên doanh token hóa, cho biết đây là “phản ứng rất tự nhiên” đối với việc một số công ty phản đối và ông dự kiến ​​​​sẽ thấy nhiều tên hơn được thêm vào danh sách.

Stocks on China's mainland have shed about $2.4 trillion since May as investors doubt AI companies can turn a profit, while U.S. restrictions and high U.S. interest rates add pressure.

By Jose Antonio Lanz Edited by Guillermo Jimenez

China and US flags in origami style. Image: Shutterstock/Decrypt

Add on Google Add Decrypt as your preferred source to see more of our stories on Google.

Stocks on China's mainland have lost about $2.4 trillion in market value since May, and the STAR 50 index of tech and chip companies is down 40% in under four months.

AI companies make up 42% of the market value of Chinese shares and 57% of trading, per Goldman Sachs, while U.S. curbs now target Chinese robots and data center parts.

Brent crude above $111 and 10-year Treasury yields near 5% are pressuring risk assets worldwide, with Bitcoin briefly under $80,000 ahead of the Fed's October 28 decision.

Stocks on China's mainland have lost about $2.4 trillion in market value, the total worth of all their shares, since May, as investors lose faith that Beijing's AI boom will ever turn a profit.

That is more than South Korea's entire economy produces in a year.

AI companies now make up 42% of the market value of Chinese shares listed on the mainland and in Hong Kong, and 57% of trading, according to Goldman Sachs . So when AI stocks fall, the whole market falls with them.

The CSI 300, an index of China's 300 biggest listed companies, entered a bear market on October 22, meaning a drop of at least 20% from its peak.

The sharpest damage hit Shanghai's STAR 50, an index of 50 large tech and chip companies. It fell 40% in less than four months, erasing about $480 billion.

It still trades at roughly 100 times earnings, a ratio that shows how many years of current profit investors are paying for, down from nearly 250 at its peak. The Nasdaq 100, the U.S. tech benchmark, sits around 30.

DeepSeek, a Chinese startup, released a cheap and powerful chatbot in January 2025, and Nvidia, the U.S. company whose chips power most AI, lost nearly $600 billion in market value in a single day. Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 , also produced by a Chinese AI lab, sent chip stocks tumbling again in July.

Beijing then pushed its tech giants toward homegrown chips: According to the Financial Times , its internet regulator reportedly told companies including ByteDance and Alibaba to stop buying Nvidia chips in September 2025. Z.ai, a Beijing lab, says it trained its GLM-5.2 model entirely on Huawei chips .

Analysts blame weak spending by Chinese consumers and doubts that AI companies can earn back what they have invested. Robot maker Unitree drew retail orders for 8,000 times the shares on offer when it listed in August, and its stock has since lost almost half its value since launch even after a significant recovery this week.

“The stock market later evolved into a speculative crazy bull,” said Dong Baozhen, a Beijing-based fund manager. “And now we see the bubble bursting.”

The U.S. Federal Communications Commission banned imports of new foreign-made humanoid robots in July on national security grounds. Washington is also moving to ban Chinese-made optical parts from U.S. data centers, and the makers Zhongji Innolight and Eoptolink are down about 60% from their peaks.

Cổ phiếu ở Trung Quốc đại lục đã giảm khoảng 2,4 nghìn tỷ USD kể từ tháng 5 do các nhà đầu tư nghi ngờ các công ty AI có thể kiếm được lợi nhuận, trong khi các hạn chế của Mỹ và lãi suất cao của Mỹ gây thêm áp lực.

Cổ phiếu ở Trung Quốc đại lục đã mất khoảng 2,4 nghìn tỷ USD giá trị thị trường kể từ tháng 5 và chỉ số STAR 50 của các công ty công nghệ và chip giảm 40% trong vòng chưa đầy 4 tháng.

Theo Goldman Sachs, các công ty AI chiếm 42% giá trị thị trường của cổ phiếu Trung Quốc và 57% giao dịch, trong khi các biện pháp hạn chế của Hoa Kỳ hiện nhắm vào robot và các bộ phận trung tâm dữ liệu của Trung Quốc.

Dầu thô Brent trên 111 USD và lãi suất trái phiếu kho bạc kỳ hạn 10 năm gần 5% đang gây áp lực lên các tài sản rủi ro trên toàn thế giới, trong đó Bitcoin có thời điểm giảm xuống dưới 80.000 USD trước quyết định ngày 28 tháng 10 của Fed.Cổ phiếu ở Trung Quốc đại lục đã mất khoảng 2,4 nghìn tỷ USD giá trị thị trường, tổng giá trị của tất cả cổ phiếu của họ, kể từ tháng 5, khi các nhà đầu tư mất niềm tin rằng sự bùng nổ AI của Bắc Kinh sẽ mang lại lợi nhuận.

Con số này nhiều hơn toàn bộ nền kinh tế Hàn Quốc sản xuất trong một năm.

Theo Goldman Sachs, các công ty AI hiện chiếm 42% giá trị thị trường của cổ phiếu Trung Quốc niêm yết ở đại lục và Hồng Kông, đồng thời chiếm 57% giao dịch. Vì vậy, khi cổ phiếu AI giảm giá, toàn bộ thị trường cũng giảm theo.

CSI 300, chỉ số của 300 công ty niêm yết lớn nhất Trung Quốc, bước vào thị trường giá xuống vào ngày 22 tháng 10, nghĩa là giảm ít nhất 20% so với mức đỉnh.

Thiệt hại nặng nề nhất xảy ra với STAR 50 của Thượng Hải, chỉ số của 50 công ty công nghệ và chip lớn. Nó đã giảm 40% trong vòng chưa đầy bốn tháng, xóa đi khoảng 480 tỷ USD.

Nó vẫn giao dịch ở mức gấp khoảng 100 lần thu nhập, một tỷ lệ cho thấy số năm lợi nhuận mà các nhà đầu tư hiện tại phải trả, giảm từ mức gần 250 vào thời kỳ đỉnh cao. Chỉ số Nasdaq 100, chuẩn mực công nghệ của Hoa Kỳ, nằm ở khoảng 30.

DeepSeek, một công ty khởi nghiệp Trung Quốc, đã phát hành một chatbot giá rẻ và mạnh mẽ vào tháng 1 năm 2025, và Nvidia, công ty Hoa Kỳ có chip hỗ trợ nhiều AI nhất, đã mất gần 600 tỷ USD giá trị thị trường chỉ trong một ngày. Kimi K3 của Moonshot AI, cũng do phòng thí nghiệm AI Trung Quốc sản xuất, đã khiến cổ phiếu chip lại sụt giảm trong tháng 7.

Sau đó, Bắc Kinh đã đẩy những gã khổng lồ công nghệ của mình hướng tới những con chip cây nhà lá vườn: Theo Financial Times, cơ quan quản lý internet của họ được cho là đã yêu cầu các công ty bao gồm ByteDance và Alibaba ngừng mua chip Nvidia vào tháng 9 năm 2025. Z.ai, một phòng thí nghiệm ở Bắc Kinh, cho biết họ đã đào tạo mẫu GLM-5.2 của mình hoàn toàn trên chip Huawei.

Các nhà phân tích đổ lỗi cho việc người tiêu dùng Trung Quốc chi tiêu yếu kém và nghi ngờ liệu các công ty AI có thể thu lại số tiền họ đã đầu tư hay không. Nhà sản xuất robot Unitree đã nhận được đơn đặt hàng bán lẻ gấp 8.000 lần số cổ phiếu được chào bán khi niêm yết vào tháng 8 và cổ phiếu của họ kể từ đó đã mất gần một nửa giá trị kể từ khi ra mắt ngay cả sau khi phục hồi đáng kể trong tuần này.

Dong Baozhen, một nhà quản lý quỹ có trụ sở tại Bắc Kinh, cho biết: “Thị trường chứng khoán sau đó đã phát triển thành một con bò điên đầu cơ”. “Và bây giờ chúng ta thấy bong bóng vỡ.”

Ủy ban Truyền thông Liên bang Hoa Kỳ đã cấm nhập khẩu robot hình người mới do nước ngoài sản xuất vào tháng 7 vì lý do an ninh quốc gia. Washington cũng đang tiến hành cấm các bộ phận quang học do Trung Quốc sản xuất khỏi các trung tâm dữ liệu của Hoa Kỳ và các nhà sản xuất Zhongji Innolight và Eoptolink đã giảm khoảng 60% so với mức đỉnh.

posts.title: Bitget Wallet Brings USD and EUR Virtual Accounts, Converting Traditional Payments to Stablecoins
posts.titleVi: Ví Bitget mang đến tài khoản ảo USD và EUR, chuyển đổi thanh toán truyền thống sang Stablecoin
posts.summary: Bitget is now bringing USD and EUR virtual accounts to over 100 million users, converting incoming bank transfers into stablecoins. Each new account comes with a personal USD or EUR account number, according to a press release shared with CryptoPotato .
posts.summaryVi: Bitget hiện đang đưa tài khoản ảo USD và EUR tới hơn 100 triệu người dùng, chuyển đổi các khoản chuyển khoản ngân hàng đến thành stablecoin. Mỗi tài khoản mới đều có số tài khoản USD hoặc EUR cá nhân, theo thông cáo báo chí được chia sẻ với CryptoPotato.
posts.content:
Bitget is now bringing USD and EUR virtual accounts to over 100 million users, converting incoming bank transfers into stablecoins.

Each new account comes with a personal USD or EUR account number, according to a press release shared with CryptoPotato . This means deposits can arrive through ACH, Fedwire, SEPA, or SWIFT and convert automatically to USDT or USDC inside the self-custodial wallet. The quote also leaves out a network fee for the stablecoin conversion.

This is possible thanks to a partnership with Noah, a stablecoin payments provider that also offers Ledger’s cash-to-stablecoin product, which gives users EUR and USD accounts. Ethena’s Pay app offers similar fiat account numbers tied to self-custodial stablecoin wallets.

“For most people, opening a dollar or euro account is close to impossible,” said Shah Ramezani, founder and CEO of Noah.

Opening an account is free, and only incoming transfers work for now. Bitget Wallet plans to add outbound transfers in the coming months. Bitget Wallet aims the accounts at freelancers paid by US or EU employers and at families receiving remittances, the release said.

USD deposits are capped at $10,000 per transaction and $20,000 a month, according to the virtual account FAQ on Bitget Wallet’s website. EUR deposits top out at €15,000 per transaction and €30,000 a month. Non-personal USD transfers above $5,000 go through additional review.

The same FAQ says the product is not a bank account. It receives transfers but offers no cash deposits, cash withdrawals, or other standard banking services.

Users do not need to live in the US or Europe, the release said. Though they must still live in a supported country and pass identity verification, the FAQ says, and some regions get only one of the two currencies.

A $500 ACH deposit costs about $2 in Bitget Wallet fees, the release said. It compared that with a global average remittance cost of around 6%, citing World Bank data. The World Bank’s remittance price tracker puts the latest global average at 6.36% of the amount sent.

Bitget Wallet’s quote covers only its own charges. Those charges combine a fixed fee with a percentage that varies by transfer method, and evidently the sending bank can also charge its own fees.

posts.contentVi:
Bitget hiện đang đưa tài khoản ảo USD và EUR tới hơn 100 triệu người dùng, chuyển đổi các khoản chuyển khoản ngân hàng đến thành stablecoin.

Mỗi tài khoản mới đều có số tài khoản USD hoặc EUR cá nhân, theo thông cáo báo chí được chia sẻ với CryptoPotato. Điều này có nghĩa là tiền gửi có thể đến thông qua ACH, Fedwire, SEPA hoặc SWIFT và tự động chuyển đổi sang USDT hoặc USDC bên trong ví tự giám sát. Báo giá cũng không tính phí mạng cho việc chuyển đổi stablecoin.

Điều này có thể thực hiện được nhờ sự hợp tác với Noah, một nhà cung cấp thanh toán stablecoin cũng cung cấp sản phẩm chuyển tiền mặt sang stablecoin của Ledger, cung cấp cho người dùng tài khoản EUR và USD. Ứng dụng Pay của ETH cung cấp số tài khoản tiền pháp định tương tự gắn với ví tiền ổn định tự quản lý.

Shah Ramezani, người sáng lập và CEO của Noah cho biết: “Đối với hầu hết mọi người, việc mở tài khoản bằng đô la hoặc euro là điều gần như không thể.

Việc mở tài khoản là miễn phí và hiện tại chỉ có các khoản chuyển khoản đến mới hoạt động. Ví Bitget có kế hoạch bổ sung chuyển khoản ra nước ngoài trong những tháng tới. Bản phát hành cho biết Ví Bitget nhắm đến các tài khoản tại những người làm nghề tự do được trả lương bởi các nhà tuyển dụng ở Hoa Kỳ hoặc EU và tại các gia đình nhận tiền chuyển tiền.

Tiền gửi bằng USD được giới hạn ở mức 10.000 USD cho mỗi giao dịch và 20.000 USD một tháng, theo Câu hỏi thường gặp về tài khoản ảo trên trang web của Bitget Wallet. Tiền gửi EUR đứng đầu ở mức € 15.000 cho mỗi giao dịch và € 30.000 một tháng. Chuyển khoản USD phi cá nhân trên 5.000 USD sẽ được xem xét bổ sung.

Câu hỏi thường gặp tương tự cho biết sản phẩm không phải là tài khoản ngân hàng. Nó nhận chuyển khoản nhưng không cung cấp tiền gửi bằng tiền mặt, rút ​​​​tiền mặt hoặc các dịch vụ ngân hàng tiêu chuẩn khác.

Bản phát hành cho biết người dùng không cần phải sống ở Mỹ hoặc Châu Âu. Mặc dù họ vẫn phải sống ở một quốc gia được hỗ trợ và vượt qua quá trình xác minh danh tính, Câu hỏi thường gặp cho biết và một số khu vực chỉ nhận được một trong hai loại tiền tệ.

Bản phát hành cho biết khoản tiền gửi 500 đô la ACH có giá khoảng 2 đô la phí Ví Bitget. Nó so sánh con số đó với chi phí chuyển tiền trung bình toàn cầu khoảng 6%, trích dẫn dữ liệu của Ngân hàng Thế giới. Công cụ theo dõi giá chuyển tiền của Ngân hàng Thế giới đưa ra mức trung bình toàn cầu mới nhất là 6,36% số tiền gửi.

Báo giá của Bitget Wallet chỉ bao gồm các khoản phí riêng. Các khoản phí đó kết hợp một khoản phí cố định với tỷ lệ phần trăm thay đổi tùy theo phương thức chuyển khoản và rõ ràng là ngân hàng gửi cũng có thể tính phí riêng của mình.

Bên cạnh việc viết nội dung, José còn là một nhà báo tài chính và blockchain với hơn 5 năm kinh nghiệm, đưa tin tức mới nhất về Web3, DeFi, GameFi và mọi thứ về tiền điện tử.

OpenAI claims a cryptography breakthrough. Does that threaten Bitcoin?

The claim concerns the Exponential Time Hypothesis. Independent scrutiny is open, and a practical Bitcoin attack would require several further steps.

By Liam 'Akiba' Wright Editor-in-Chief • CryptoSlate

01 OpenAI claims an Exponential Time Hypothesis refutation, while researchers are organizing an independent examination of the result. 02 The disclosed SAT speed-up does not establish a practical attack on Bitcoin mining or spending signatures. 03 The Lean formalization covers a weaker subexponential time bound than the manuscript’s sharpest claim. Make CryptoSlate preferred on Share

OpenAI says its AI system has refuted the Exponential Time Hypothesis, a longstanding assumption about how difficult certain logic problems are to solve. The Oct. 26 announcement has researchers organizing an independent examination. The disclosed result does not establish a practical attack on Bitcoin.

ETH here means Exponential Time Hypothesis, rather than Ether. The subject is 3-SAT, a puzzle in which a computer must find true-or-false settings that satisfy a collection of logical rules. The hypothesis says solving these problems requires exponential time in the number of variables in the worst case.

OpenAI says the result was verified in Lean, a proof assistant, although its scope note describes a weaker time bound than the manuscript's sharpest claim. The researchers organizing the community's examination have expressly declined to certify it. Their letter says, “Our involvement should not be taken as certification of the claim.”

The manuscript , dated Oct. 17 and revised Oct. 25, claims a deterministic algorithm that exactly counts the satisfying assignments of fixed-width Boolean formulas in subexponential time and polynomial space. In plain English, its running time grows more slowly than an exponential bound as the problem gets larger. That is a different promise from making the problem easy on today's computers.

The disclosed bound does not establish a polynomial-time algorithm or settle P=NP, the question of whether every decision problem whose proposed solutions can be verified in polynomial time can also be solved in polynomial time.

CryptoSlate's examination of the paper is limited to its introductory pages 1–8, rather than a review of the full proof.

A SAT claim. A missing bridge to a Bitcoin attack.

OpenAI's claimed ETH refutation concerns formula solving. Mining and spending pose different concrete tasks.

A subexponential SAT bound does not by itself demonstrate a practical Bitcoin attack.

The ETH refutation is OpenAI's claim pending independent scrutiny. Paper evidence is limited to introductory pages 1–8. No attack times, encoding sizes, benchmarks or independent cryptographic audit are established.
